chunks: Some of them will believe in it, some will not. Your Lord knows the transgressors well.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about those who believe and those who do not?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Yunus, this verse underscores the divine wisdom in allowing mixed reactions to prophetic messages, reflecting the reality of human free will. Shia scholarship often views this diversity as a test of sincerity, where God’s ultimate knowledge ('Aalam bil-mufsideen') distinguishes between superficial belief and genuine adherence to the truth amidst corruption.
